VanillaPsycastsExpanded.PsycasterPathDef.label: phantom hand
VanillaPsycastsExpanded.PsycasterPathDef.description: Phantom hands shape raw telekinetic force into hands that work, rescue and fight on their own.
VanillaPsycastsExpanded.PsycasterPathDef.tooltip: Phantom hands summon short-lived telekinetic hands that haul, cut, build, carry the wounded and fight for the colony. Mud and shallow water don't slow them, and they fade within an in-game hour. The caster's psychic sensitivity sets how many come, how fast they move and how skilled they are.
